$comment: Part II Section B — power(s) of attorney for the economic operator's representative(s). Hand-authored (administrative, not a criterion). CAVEAT: no Schematron rule and no instance in ESPD-Request/Response-BASE.xml constrain or exemplify PowerOfAttorney/AgentParty — this shape is derived from the EA I72 'info-poa' model and the UBL 2.4 PowerOfAttorneyType (Description optional, AgentParty mandatory). Fields are therefore modelled as what UBL allows, all optional except where UBL makes them mandatory. REVIEW against a real instance when one is available (same situation Part I §A was in before a sample was supplied).
title: ESPD Part II Section B — Power of Attorney

powersOfAttorney.description: Zero or more powers of attorney (EA I72 PowerOfAttorney, cardinality 0..n). Each maps to one cac:PowerOfAttorney under cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:Party.

powerOfAttorney.description: One power of attorney. Maps to cac:PowerOfAttorney: an optional Description plus the mandatory AgentParty (the representative).

description.description: Free-text description of the mandate. Maps to cac:PowerOfAttorney/cbc:Description (optional in UBL).

agentParty.description: The representative holding the mandate. Maps to cac:PowerOfAttorney/cac:AgentParty (a cac:Party, mandatory in UBL PowerOfAttorneyType). No Schematron rule constrains its contents; name and identifier are modelled as the practical minimum, address/contact as optional. All subfields optional at the schema level since none is mandated.

name.description: Name of the representative. Maps to cac:Party/cac:PartyName/cbc:Name.

country.description: Country of the representative, as a Country code. Maps to cac:Party/cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode.

agentIdentifier.description: An identifier for the representative. Maps to cac:Party/cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID with a mandatory @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02, fatal, applies to every cbc:ID). There is no scheme to derive an agency from, so @schemeAgencyID is supplied as a constant 'OP' at export, not stored here.

value.description: The identifier value. Maps to the text of cbc:ID.
